commonMistakes: A partly correct response can still miss a required form, unit, relationship or mark point.
detailedExplanation: Verified against The Tiffin Girls’ School Year 9 Chemistry Curriculum Outline 2026–27 (AQA GCSE Chemistry 8462).
The modern atmosphere is approximately 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen. Most of the remainder is argon, with carbon dioxide present at about 0.04%; water vapour is variable.
When working with simplified percentage questions, add the stated major gases and subtract from 100%. Keep the distinction between an approximate school model and a precisely measured composition.
examTips: Use the command word and number of marks to decide how many distinct points are required.
Use precise terminology and link cause to effect rather than listing disconnected facts.
For calculations, show the relationship, substitution, working and unit.

additionalSourceSections.heading: Composition
additionalSourceSections.body:
Present atmosphere (approx.):
Nitrogen ≈ 78%
Oxygen ≈ 21%
Argon and other gases ≈ 1%
Carbon dioxide ≈ 0.04%
Water vapour varies with place and conditions.
